title: Product of norms in a monotonicity family
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional cube over the two-element field. Form the family on the $(k+1)$-dimensional cube by taking the function $f$ when the last coordinate is $0$ and the constant function $1$ when it is $1$. The product of the order-$(k+1)$ Gowers norms of these functions over all cube indices equals the order-$(k+1)$ Gowers norm of $f$ raised to $2^k$.
hypotheses_covered: n and k are natural numbers
f is a real-valued function on the n-dimensional binary cube
